stern-fonds-sexueller-missbrauch-2025.titel: State cuts support for those affected by sexualised violence
stern-fonds-sexueller-missbrauch-2025.beschreibung:
The Fonds Sexueller Missbrauch (sexual abuse fund) helped many of those affected where other systems were too slow, too complicated or not sufficiently accessible. Now exactly this support is being phased out.

The article in stern shows what consequences this can have for those affected – and why the decision means far more than a budget cut. KE!N EINZELFALL also has its say and makes clear what the fund was actually able to achieve in everyday life.

Why its loss is so serious for many people and what gap it leaves behind, you can read in the full article.

petition-erst-versorgung-sichern.titel: Secure care first – then change care benefits!
petition-erst-versorgung-sichern.beschreibung:
Care has to work in practice – not just on paper.

People in need of care and their families depend on reliable support. At the same time, carers, facilities and services are already under enormous pressure. Staff shortages, rising costs and growing bureaucracy make care that meets people's needs more difficult.

With the planned changes under the care reform, a crucial question arises: What happens if benefits are changed or cut before working alternatives are available?

As a non-profit victim support association, KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. does not want to block necessary reforms. But we demand that care for people in need of it remains secure and that changes do not come at the expense of those who depend on support or provide it every day.

With our petition ‘Secure care first – then change care benefits!’ we are calling for the experiences of those affected, their families and professionals to be taken into account in political decisions.

Take part now – every signature counts!

Support our petition, share it with others or collect signatures yourself. People without internet access should also be able to take part.
petition-erst-versorgung-sichern.dokumente_einleitung: To reach as many people as possible, we provide our materials for reading, printing and passing on (in German).
petition-erst-versorgung-sichern.nachtext:
Your experiences matter!

What challenges do you face in care or support? What effects could changes have on your everyday life, your family or your work?

We want to make these experiences and assessments visible. Write to us at petition@kein-einzelfall.de.

Because a good care reform has to reach people – not just exist on paper.

petition-tour41-fonds-sexueller-missbrau.titel: The “Fonds Sexueller Missbrauch” (sexual abuse fund) must be preserved!
petition-tour41-fonds-sexueller-missbrau.beschreibung:
The petition by Tour41 e. V. calls for the preservation of the Fonds Sexueller Missbrauch (FSM). The fund offers people affected by sexual abuse within the family low-threshold support in the form of benefits in kind and, in the association's view, must not fall victim to budget cuts.

We at KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. expressly support this concern and welcome every additional signature.

ehrenamtsmesse-berlin-2026.beschreibung:
A wonderful day at the volunteering fair in Berlin!

Our stand was staffed by our 1st chairwoman Tatjana Belmar, our treasurer Petra Hildebrandt and our founding member Nicole Khalil. Nicole also represents KE!N EINZELFALL e. V. on the Berlin State Advisory Council for People with Disabilities.

We had many great conversations, made new contacts and met interesting people. Our stand was outdoors – and the weather played along wonderfully.

We take away many lovely encounters and new ideas and are already looking forward to being there again next year!
